item.tib: g.yang sgrub 'dod 'byung nor bu longs spyod dbyar mtsho rgyas byed nya gang zla ba
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni grwa btsun sbyin pa sogs kyis snga mo nas bskul kyang skya ser mang 'tshogs la sngon 'gro bka' lung rgya mtsho dang / sgrub gra la sde snod mdzod 'chad khul dang / khyad par rang gis kyang lung rigs mdzod la skyor sbyangs byed pa sogs kyis phyir 'gyangs su gyur tshe/ rnal 'byor ba nges don gyis nyams su lon nges pa zhig nye bar dang du longs shig gi bskul ma tshigs su bcad pa ngo mtshar nor bu'i phreng ba sprengs (springs) bas khyim gyi nor bu la brten de theg mchog bstan pa'i nyi mar 'bod pas bgrang bya bcu drug lor sbyar ba'o//
